label: Lab 12
title: How many strangers can the space hold?
question: Before a public link to the agent space is shared, how many anonymous guests can one space take before it falls behind?
how: The capacity sheet's estimate, made on another machine, beside a fresh run of the same load tool on a Mac, on an isolated instance. The two are boxed apart.
